current.title: ✂️ 选择导出 / Partial export
current.summary: 导出按钮新增「选择导出」可勾选部分消息；并自动隐藏官方那条抢位又难用的右侧导航。
current.bodyMarkdown:
## 中文 — 常用功能

- **时间线 (Timeline)**：右侧紫色小豆豆，每条对话一个，鼠标悬浮看预览、点击跳转。
- **图钉 (Pins)**：长回答里点段落可以钉住，小豆豆上会显示钉子标记，上下箭头在同一段对话内的钉子之间切换。
- **收藏 / 收藏夹**：preview row 上点星标即可收藏；点悬浮面板底栏「Favorites」打开收藏夹，**跨对话**的收藏也能看。
- **导出对话**：右上角 Share 旁边的 ⬇ 按钮点开是个小菜单——「整个导出」一键导出当前对话，或「选择导出」勾选要的消息只导出那几条；格式在扩展弹窗「对话导出」一栏切换（标准 / 简化 Markdown、标准 / 简化 JSON、HTML）。
- **临时反悔（Undo temp）**：临时对话右上角的反悔按钮，一键把当前临时对话作为前情提要带到一段全新的正式对话里——不丢上下文。
- **Prompt 管理器**：右下角悬浮球，存提示词、tag、搜索、点一下复制或插入到输入框。
- **公式点击复制**：渲染好的公式直接点就复制 LaTeX；扩展弹窗里可切 LaTeX / MathML / 无美元符号 / Notion ($$) 几种格式。
- **布局调整**：扩展弹窗里有滑块改聊天宽度、聊天字号、代码块字号、输入框宽度、侧边栏宽度。

## 1.6.8 新增

- **✂️ 选择导出**：导出按钮现在点开是个菜单。选「选择导出」进入勾选模式——每条消息左上角一个紫色复选框，配「全选 / 仅你 / 仅 ChatGPT」，只下载你勾的那几条。底层和整段导出共用同一套导出器和格式设置，质量一致。
- **🧹 自动隐藏官方那条难用的右侧导航**：ChatGPT 最近自己上了个右侧 prompt 导航条——一排小横杠，功能简陋（没序号、没收藏、没预览），活像我们 Timeline 的拙劣模仿，还跟我们的 Timeline 抢同一条右边缘挤成一团锯齿。现在只要 Voyager 的 Timeline 开着，就自动把它藏掉，右边清清爽爽；真要官方那个的话，把我们的 Timeline 关掉它自己就回来。
- **📦 版本说明**：本次 v1.6.8 先在 **GitHub 发布**（[Releases](https://github.com/TanChuping/chatgpt-voyager/releases) 里可直接下载安装）。Chrome / Edge 商店版需要几天审核，**预计 6 月 7 日前通过**——想现在就用，去 GitHub 装最新的即可。

## 🗂️ 1.6.11 修复

- 拖对话进文件夹时不再错放成最上面那条——你拖哪条进的，进文件夹的就是哪条。

## 反馈

有需求 / 发现 bug 欢迎到 [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/TanChuping/chatgpt-voyager/issues) 提一下。

---

## English — common features

- **Timeline** — Purple dots on the right side, one per turn. Hover to preview, click to jump.
- **Pins** — Pin specific paragraphs inside long answers; the dot shows a pin marker, up/down arrows cycle pins within the same turn.
- **Favorites** — Star any preview row; open the favorites panel from the floating panel's footer "Favorites" button — also works across conversations.
- **Conversation export** — The ⬇ button next to Share now opens a small menu: **Entire conversation** (one-click) or **Select & export** (tick messages, download only those). Pick a format in the popup's "Conversation export" section (standard / simplified Markdown, standard / simplified JSON, or HTML).
- **Undo temp** — A regret button in the top-right of every temporary chat. One click captures the whole temp conversation and hands it off to a fresh persistent chat — context preserved.
- **Prompt Manager** — Floating ball bottom-right. Stores prompts with tags + search; click to copy or insert.
- **Formula click-to-copy** — Click any rendered formula to copy its LaTeX. Format (LaTeX / MathML / no-dollar / Notion) configurable in the popup.
- **Layout sliders** — Chat width, chat font size, code block font size, composer width, sidebar width — all in the extension popup.

## What's new in 1.6.8

- **✂️ Partial export** — the export button now opens a menu. Choose **Select & export** to enter a selection mode: a purple checkbox on each message, plus *Select all / Only you / Only ChatGPT*, downloading only what you ticked. It reuses the exact same exporters and format choice as the full export.
- **🧹 Auto-hides ChatGPT's clunky new right-edge nav** — ChatGPT recently shipped its own right-side "prompt" navigation: a row of tiny dashes, no indices, no favorites, no preview — a crude imitation of our Timeline that pins to the same right edge and overlaps ours into a jagged bar. While Voyager's Timeline is on, we now hide it automatically; turn our Timeline off and the native one comes back.
- **📦 Release note** — v1.6.8 ships on **GitHub first** (grab it from [Releases](https://github.com/TanChuping/chatgpt-voyager/releases)). The Chrome / Edge store build is in review and **should be approved before June 7** — install from GitHub if you want it now.

## 🗂️ Fixed in 1.6.11

- Dragging a conversation into a folder no longer grabs the topmost one by mistake — the conversation you drag is the one that lands.

## Feedback

Drop requests / bugs at [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/TanChuping/chatgpt-voyager/issues).
